title: Training-Free Policy Violation Detection via Activation-Space Whitening in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2512.03994v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As organizations increasingly deploy LLMs in sensitive domains such as legal, financial, and medical settings, ensuring alignment with internal organizational policies has become a priority. Existing content moderation frameworks remain largely confined to the safety domain and lack the robustness to capture nuanced organizational policies. LLM-as-a-judge and fine-tuning approaches, though flexible, introduce significant latency and training cost. To address these limitations, we frame policy violation detection as an out-of-distribution (OOD) problem in the model's activation space. We propose a training-free method that operates directly on the LLM internal representations, leveraging prior evidence that decision-relevant information is encoded within them. Inspired by whitening techniques, we derive policy-violation scores directly from normalized representations of LLM hidden activations. Our method requires only the policy text

translated_title: 无需训练的大语言模型策略违规检测：基于激活空间白化的方法
translated_abstract: 随着各组织越来越多地在法律、金融和医疗等敏感领域部署大语言模型（LLM），确保其与组织内部政策保持一致已成为优先事项。现有的内容审核框架大多仍局限于安全领域，缺乏捕捉细致组织政策的鲁棒性。LLM-as-a-judge（大模型作为裁判）和微调方法虽然灵活，但会引入显著的延迟和训练成本。为解决这些局限性，我们将策略违规检测构建为模型激活空间中的分布外（OOD）问题。我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，直接作用于LLM的内部表示，并利用了先前的研究证据——即与决策相关的信息编码在这些内部表示中。受白化技术的启发，我们从LLM隐层激活的归一化表示中直接推导出策略违规分数。我们的方法只需要政策文本即可运行。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的策略违规检测方法，将违规检测建模为LLM激活空间中的分布外问题，受白化技术启发从隐层激活的归一化表示中直接计算策略违规分数，仅需政策文本即可实现低延迟、低成本的组织政策合规检测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a training-free policy violation detection method that frames the task as an out-of-distribution problem in LLM activation space, deriving policy-violation scores directly from whitened hidden activations using only the policy text.
